findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Nhân viên Bảo trì & Tự động hóa công nghiệp." → 3 lines (10 words, 60px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 7 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "SẴN SÀNG NHẬN VIỆC (OPEN TO WORK)" (pill) above "Nhân viên Bảo trì & Tự động hóa công ngh"; "01 / VỀ TÔI & ĐỊNH HƯỚNG" (pill) above "Tư duy máy móc & Trách nhiệm nhà xưởng"; "02 / NĂNG LỰC CHUYÊN MÔN" (pill) above "Kỹ năng kỹ thuật & Công cụ làm chủ"; "03 / DỰ ÁN TIÊU BIỂU" (pill) above "Đồ án kỹ thuật & Mô hình thực tế"; "04 / THƯ NGỎ ỨNG TUYỂN" (pill) above "Thư gửi Nhà tuyển dụng"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: JetBrains Mono — e.g. "MECHATRONICS & AUTOMATION ENG", "Tải CV", "LHU", "Top"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01 / VỀ TÔI & ĐỊNH HƯỚNG", "02 / NĂNG LỰC CHUYÊN MÔN", "03 / DỰ ÁN TIÊU BIỂU", "04 / THƯ NGỎ ỨNG TUYỂN", "05 / HỒ SƠ LÝ LỊCH & CV", "06 / KẾT NỐI TRỰC TIẾP"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 7 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "THÔNG TIN CÁ NHÂN", "01 / VỀ TÔI & ĐỊNH HƯỚNG", "02 / NĂNG LỰC CHUYÊN MÔN", "03 / DỰ ÁN TIÊU BIỂU").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): div.relative.w-48 → linear-gradient(to right top, rgb(3, 105, 161), rgb(56, 189, 248), rgb(37, 99, 235))
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 1 gradient-filled text element(s).
findings.fix: Solid colour text.

findings.message: 26 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.relative.w-full → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(15, 23, | div.inline-flex.items-center → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | a.w-full.sm:w-auto → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(2, 132,
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 29 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.sticky.top-0 1440px | section#hero.relative.pt-12 1440px | div.grid.grid-cols-3 512px | div.flex.items-center 406px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 27 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 4 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (3 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "STATUS: SENIOR STUDENT (NĂM CUỐI)" 2.6:1 needs 4.5:1; "TOP CẤP TRƯỜNG" 3.2:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: 2 clip(s) without a poster.
findings.fix: Give every clip a poster frame: in the study of 100 Sites of the Day only 31% had one, and the blank or grey boxes before the clips played were recorded as faults (references/imagery.md §11).

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 100 characters per line.
findings.fix: Cap paragraphs at 45–75 characters (max-width: 60ch).

findings.message: 77 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: Broken image(s): https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1581092335397-9583fe92d232?auto=format&fit=crop&w=700&q=80
findings.fix: Fix the URL or replace the asset.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 60px (4.2vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: The sheet dealt Hanken Grotesk and Hanken Grotesk, but the page renders Plus Jakarta Sans, JetBrains Mono.
findings.fix: Load the dealt face (the link on the sheet) and put it first in font-family. A build that falls back to a default face lands on the default look.

findings.message: The margins differ: 112px on the left, 132px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: Only 2 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.
